INSERT INTO sr_dag_node_instance (dag_instance_id, node_id, node_name_snapshot, handler_name_snapshot, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{dagInstanceId}, #{n.nodeId}, #{n.nodeName}, #{n.handlerName}, 0, 0, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT ni.id FROM sr_dag_node_instance ni JOIN sr_dag_instance di ON di.id = ni.dag_instance_id WHERE ni.dag_instance_id = #{dagInstanceId} AND ni.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sr_dag_edge e JOIN sr_dag_node_instance pred ON pred.dag_instance_id = ni.dag_instance_id AND pred.node_id = e.from_node_id WHERE e.dag_definition_version_id = di.dag_definition_version_id AND e.to_node_id = ni.node_id AND pred.status != 50 )
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_dag_node_instance SET status = 10, input_bindings_snapshot = CAST(#{bindings} AS JSONB), ready_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND status = 0

UPDATE sr_dag_node_instance SET status = 20, dispatch_owner = #{dispatchOwner}, dispatch_lease_expire_time = #{dispatchLeaseExpireTime}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND status = 10
UPDATE sr_dag_node_instance SET status = 30, dispatched_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND status = 20
UPDATE sr_dag_node_instance SET status = 40, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{now}), version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND status = 30
mapper.select: UPDATE sr_dag_node_instance SET status = 50, result_json = CAST(#{resultJson} AS JSONB), result_ref = #{resultRef}, finished_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND status = 40 RETURNING id, dag_instance_id, node_id, handler_name_snapshot, finished_at
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_dag_node_instance SET status = 60, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND status = 40
UPDATE sr_dag_node_instance SET status = 80, finished_at = #{now}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND status = 0

UPDATE sr_dag_node_instance SET status = 10, retry_count = #{retryCount}, current_attempt_no = #{currentAttemptNo}, next_schedule_time = #{nextScheduleTime}, dispatch_owner = NULL, dispatch_lease_expire_time = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{nodeInstanceId} AND status IN (20, 30, 40, 90)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sr_dag_node_instance WHERE status = 20 AND dispatch_lease_expire_time < #{now} ORDER BY dispatch_lease_expire_time, id LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 50) AS success_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 60) AS failed_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 80) AS skipped_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 90)) AS active_count FROM sr_dag_node_instance WHERE dag_instance_id = #{dagInstanceId}
